summary: Hierarchy of control, not of model names. The scheduled unit is the WORK PACKET; each attempt carries its own execution plan (model, effort, mode, context policy, verifier, escalation).

owns: cross-check of Root at major locks

root.session: long-lived logically; rotates physically via root_handoff

owns: one coherent wave: decomposition, dependency graph, parallelism, same vs fresh session, model + effort per attempt, context packet, verification requests, retry, escalation, rejection, consolidation
governor.session: one fresh session per wave; closed after the wave result is returned

owns: one packet attempt within its context packet
independent verification of a packet or wave; never the author of what it verifies

routing_objective: cheapest VERIFIED execution plan that stays safely above required reliability (expected total resource to a verified result: first attempt + review + retry + escalation + rework + integration + context replay)
